newsitem.title: USA: Tarrant Apparel sees higher Q4 sales, net.
newsitem.headline: Tarrant Apparel sees higher Q4 sales, net.

text.p: Tarrant Apparel Group on Wednesday said it expects fourth quarter sales to improve at least 25 percent over the year-earlier period and earnings to be up at least 50 percent.
In a statement, the company said it received over $10 million in orders for fourth quarter delivery from one of its newer customers.

"As we look forward, such programs give us continued confidence about revenue levels for fourth quarter and beyond. In particular, we anticipate that fourth quarter sales and earnings per share will improve at least 25 and 50 percent, respectively, from the same period last year."
Tarrant reported proforma earnings of $0.21 a share on sales of $44.2 million in the year-ago fourth quarter.

Tarrant Apparel Group serves both specialty retail and mass merchandise store chains by designing, merchandising, contracting for the manufacture of and selling casual, moderately priced apparel, primarily for women, under private label.
